instructions.name: House Style
instructions.instructions:
Enforce our conventions:
- Public functions and exported types must have a doc comment.
- Prefer early returns over deeply nested conditionals.
- No TODO/FIXME left without a linked ticket id.

instructions.name: TypeScript Quality
instructions.instructions:
- No `any` to silence the compiler — prefer `unknown` + narrowing.
- Explicit return types on exported functions.
- No non-null `!` assertions that paper over a possibly-undefined value.

instructions.name: Payments Safety
instructions.instructions:
- Never log full card numbers, CVV, or raw payment tokens.
- All money math uses integer minor units (cents), never floats.
- Idempotency keys are required on every charge/refund call.

instructions.name: Node Performance
instructions.instructions: Node hot paths: flag `await` inside a loop over independent work (use `Promise.all`), synchronous `fs`/`crypto` on a request path, and N+1 access patterns (batch or `include` in the ORM instead of per-row queries).
